answer: Because the timing is entered against the ivory challenge, the orchard audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 40 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Each duplicate costs another 44 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
